prompts.name: environments.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production environment atlas for the approved Gail and Ella story, using reference as style reference ONLY. Four precisely equal panels in a 2 by 2 grid, no gutters, full bleed; overall 1536x1024, each panel landscape 3:2. TOP LEFT castle courtyard with a small ivory castle arch door, distant tower and garden, wide clear stone paving foreground. TOP RIGHT castle playroom matching reference: pink curtains, tall arched window on right back wall, quiet muted sage and cream room with gifts and soft toys stored at far back wall only, large empty rug and floor in lower half. BOTTOM LEFT sunny open market square, fruit stalls across background, pale striped awnings, stalls containing oranges at rear, broad completely clear paving in lower half. BOTTOM RIGHT sheltered market awning interior in rain: canopy overhead, low wooden craft table against LEFT rear edge, rainy market visible behind, large clear dry tiled floor foreground, no objects on floor. Warm sophisticated tactile layered paper sculpture children's book style, realistic paper grain, gently detailed, eye-level stage, consistent light. Absolutely NO people, NO characters, NO loose oranges, NO pinwheel, NO hats, NO block towers, NO chairs in foreground, no text or labels. These are four character-free background plates for separate movable puppets. Every panel must reach its exact quadrant boundaries.

prompts.name: princess-cast.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Transparent PNG production character sprite atlas for Gail and Ella. Reference defines exact identities and clothing. Exactly 3 columns by 3 rows equal square cells, square whole canvas, one COMPLETE FULL BODY character centered in each cell, each fits within central 76% width and 84% height of cell, 8% completely transparent padding on every cell boundary. No background, no floor, no shadows outside character, NO checkerboard painted in image, actual alpha transparency. Tactile layered paper-cut illustration with cream cut-paper edge, same delicate style as reference. All characters subtly three-quarter facing viewer's RIGHT. ROW1: cell0 Ella standing neutral listening; cell1 Ella sitting on floor with knees hugged looking lonely; cell2 Ella kneeling reaching forward to pick a block but NO block drawn. ROW2: cell3 Ella standing hands covering ears politely overwhelmed; cell4 Ella standing laughing with hands clasped; cell5 Gail sitting cross-legged listening attentively. ROW3: cell6 adult caregiver warm brown hair bun, muted sage skirt cream blouse, standing kindly; cell7 little boy brown hair cream shirt sage shorts seated cross-legged; cell8 little girl dark brown hair pink bow and dusty blush dress seated cross-legged. Ella always honey-blonde bob, tiny gold crown, sage dress ivory collar, ivory socks, brown Mary Jane shoes. Gail always long brown hair gold starclip purple star pajamas cream slippers. ALL hair, crowns, fingers, shoes entirely inside their own cell. Exactly nine independent characters, no props, no text, no scene.

prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production transparent props atlas, 3 columns x 3 rows with NINE exactly equal square cells on square canvas. Each object centered well INSIDE its cell with minimum 15% transparent padding all around, never crosses cell boundary. Actual transparent alpha background, no checkerboard painted. Warm tactile layered paper-cut storybook craft style matching reference, sage green blush pink cream and warm orange, realistic paper texture and delicate cream cut edge. Row1: single pink wrapped gift with ribbon; one sage wooden cube block; a modest tall six-block pastel toy tower. No people no backgrounds no labels no shadows beyond each object. Every item distinct, complete, separate, comfortably padded inside own equal cell. The pinwheel and chair fit fully. Exactly nine items.

prompts.name: princess-cast-v2.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. EDIT THIS EXACT CHARACTER ATLAS. Remove ALL gray/white checkerboard background pixels and return a genuinely transparent RGBA PNG cutout of the nine characters. The checkerboard in input is unfortunately painted; it must be fully removed, including gaps between legs/arms. Preserve the exact nine character identities, faces, clothing, poses and paper edges. Arrange into a mathematically exact 3 by 3 equal square-cell atlas with each complete character scaled SMALLER to fit the inner 76% of its cell, leaving generous actual transparent margin at every boundary. Preserve all crowns, hair, hands and shoes. Do not draw any backdrop or checkerboard. Output true alpha transparency, like a game sprite PNG. No text, no new objects.
